name: NatureBank Asset Management Inc.
summary: NatureBank Asset Management Inc. engages in sourcing, financing, development, and commercialization of sustainable commodity projects in the agro-forestry and carbon sectors in Canada, Germany, rest of Europe, the United States, and internationally. Its agroforestry services include sustainable forest management, process improvement, and arid lands, as well as solutions for cocoa production; and ecosystem services comprise feasibility assessments, evaluation tools, forest restoration, and GIS and modeling. The company also provides carbon management services, such as project development, CCBA development, forest restoration, indigenous communities, and certification, as well as forestry, community based land management, remote sensing, and geospatial analysis services; and supply chain risk analysis, climate risk services of natural resource planning, life cycle assessment, policy and market analysis, offset project development, clean technology, and event impact management services. In addition, it offers advisory, technology, and impact investment services to public and private organizations; sells verified emission reduction units; and provides project development consulting services, and other environmental consulting services. The company was formerly known as Offsetters Climate Solutions Inc. and changed its name to NatureBank Asset Management Inc. in October 2015. NatureBank Asset Management Inc. was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
